title: Attempting to add diacritic marks Godot blocks keyboard input permanently
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in Godot v4.7.rc2.official [3df26a02c] - Reproducible in Godot v4.6.3.stable.official [7d41c59c4] ### System information Godot v4.6.3.stable - Linux Mint 22.3 (Zena) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT (RADV GFX1201) - AMD Ryzen 5 7600X3D 6-Core Processor (12 threads) - 61.88 GiB memory ### Issue description When adding a diacritic mark (¨,´,`,^) Godot stops accepting any keyboard input (this includes F1, backspace and all special characters) EXCEPT other diacritic marks This error happens everywhere you can input text: the built-in text editor, the project settings, in a textEdit node while running the project, etc. It's restricted to each window and closing and reopening fixes it. Image of the bug in action (At this point, all keyboard input is ignored) Second Image in the project showing that other diacritic marks can be added The underscore under each diacritic mark mean that a character can be added to be turned into a diacritic character (á,ö), though no character can be added due to this bug. I use a Spanish Keyboard so I have diacritic marks as keys. (NOTE: copying and pasting the characters doesn't trigger the error as it seems that the error is caused when there's a prompt to add another character) ### Steps to reproduce 1) Open the editText scene's script OR run the project (in theory you can do this anywhere you can add text) 2) Press the ´,`,¨ or ^ keys in your keyboard. (maybe a virtual keyboard could work? idk) ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [diacritic-mark-mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/28854979/diacritic-mark-mrp.zip)
